summary: Environment A evidence for a first-launch workflow walkthrough and a Diagnostics-Mode-actionable setup notice - the sixth and last-scoped Phase 6 (Operator Ergonomics) audit gap.
auditFinding: App.tsx had zero first-run affordance of any kind - no localStorage/first-run flag anywhere, every launch identical. Two genuinely different things 'onboarding' could mean (a workflow walkthrough vs. a setup-readiness checklist) were put to the operator, who chose both. While scoping the checklist half, found SystemStatusStrip already renders Bible/Speech/Display readiness in Operator Mode - what was actually missing was a path from that status to the Diagnostics Mode controls that fix it. See docs/phase-6-6-audit.md.
designChoice: AskUserQuestion: workflow walkthrough vs. setup checklist vs. both. Operator chose both.

newCode.onboardingTs: apps/desktop/src/lib/onboarding.ts: shouldShowWalkthrough(storedValue) - pure first-run-flag decision, separated from the actual localStorage read/write in the component.
newCode.onboardingWalkthroughTsx: apps/desktop/src/components/OnboardingWalkthrough.tsx: dismissible first-launch overlay explaining the Start Service -> Needs Attention -> Approve/Reject -> Display workflow, rendered from App.tsx.
newCode.setupGapsTs: apps/desktop/src/lib/setupGaps.ts: computeSetupGaps(bibleInstalled, speechStatus) - pure decision of which of two operator-actionable setup items remain, from LiveStatus fields already fetched for SystemStatusStrip.
newCode.liveChurchBrainTsx: New Operator-Mode-only banner, visible only while setupGaps.length > 0, naming outstanding items with an 'Open Diagnostics Mode' button that calls the exact same setMode('diagnostics') the header's own toggle already uses.

shows the walkthrough for an empty stored value
shows the walkthrough for any value other than the exact seen marker

reports the Bible gap when no dataset is installed

fullRegression.lint: npm run lint: same 5 pre-existing warnings as before this phase - no new ones
fullRegression.rustChanges: None - zero Rust files touched this phase, confirmed via git status, so no Rust regression re-run was needed. Third Phase 6.x frontend-only slice, after 6.2/6.3.

architecturalSafetyNotes: Zero new Tauri commands, zero new events, zero new database schema changes.
The walkthrough is dismissible with one click and never blocks any control underneath it.
The setup notice's one button calls the exact same setMode('diagnostics') the header's own toggle already uses - no new navigation mechanism.
computeSetupGaps is read-only derived state - it triggers no fetch, no command, no state write of its own.
